stem:
Priya makes a pinhole camera in her school science club in Jaipur. She points the small hole at a lamp post outside and looks at the tracing-paper screen at the back of the box.
Which description correctly gives the image she sees on the screen?

options.text: upright and the same way round as the lamp post
upside down and reversed left to right
upright but reversed left to right, like a mirror image
upside down but not reversed left to right

teacher.key_rationale: Light travels in straight lines through the pinhole, so rays from the top of the object reach the bottom of the screen and rays from the left reach the right: the image is inverted both vertically and laterally. Option A is the trap for a learner who assumes any image formed by light must be upright like the object; C reflects a mirror misconception; D is a partial inversion error.
